tours.name: Morning Kayak
tours.description: Start the day on the water. A two-hour morning paddle with coastal views and time to enjoy Cape Town from a different perspective. Choose a departure below and make the morning yours.

tours.name: Sunset Paddle
tours.description: Trade the afternoon rush for an evening on the water. This two-hour paddle follows the coast as the light softens, with the city and mountains as your backdrop. Sunset timing and routes depend on conditions.

tours.name: Midday Hike
tours.description: Take the adventure onto land with a two-hour Table Mountain hike. Enjoy the mountain scenery and a fresh perspective on Cape Town. Bring comfortable walking shoes, water and a sun hat.
